body:
## Job Purpose:

Contributes independently to setting and maintaining high quality standards and ensures that client demands and expectations are met. Focuses on preventing mistakes and defects throughout manufacturing, from design transfer to delivery and Life of Field. Conducts work in accordance with "Produce/Test Assembly" for REMS Manufacturing and the "Execute Quality", "Monitor Quality" and "Improve Quality" processes in GPBMS.

## Job Description:

Independently performs and follows up quality assurance activities within an assigned Manufacturing product or process scope. Ensures that contractual, internal and regulatory quality requirements are understood, transferred to Manufacturing and verified from design transfer through delivery.
 The role operates independently within an assigned product or process scope. It may coordinate defined quality activities and support less-experienced colleagues. 

## You are meant for this job if:

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant work experience.
• Minimum five years of relevant work experience.
• Good knowledge of Quality Assurance principles and experience applying them independently within Manufacturing.
• Good understanding of Manufacturing processes and quality follow-up.
• Experience across Manufacturing Quality activities such as inspections, documentation review, non-conformance handling, process verification and requirements follow-up.
• Ability to work systematically and independently, define priorities and follow quality activities through to completion.
• Good cooperation and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to coordinate activities across relevant functions.
• Experience participating in root cause analysis and following corrective actions through implementation.
• Good technical understanding and knowledge of relevant industry standards, such as ISO, API and NORSOK.
• Good verbal and written Norwegian and English skills.
• Experience with SAP and Teamcenter is an advantage.
• Knowledge of GPBMS and relevant quality procedures is an advantage.

## Your future at TechnipFMC:

• Your journey starts with our onboarding program
• As an international company, we provide you with great opportunities for internal growth
• You will have the opportunity to attend development activities
• We have benefits like company cabins, in-house gym, and sports teams  
• You will be secured by good insurance and retirements plans 
• Collaborative and innovative atmosphere that promotes teamwork.

## Practicalites:

• Application date:17th November 2026, candidates will be evaluated on a continuing basis
• Place of work: Kongsberg, Norway
• Candidates must be able to legally work and reside in Norway, without sponsorship
• For more information, please contact Manager Maciej Munski, Maciej.Munski@technipfmc.com
